doc.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995

title: Friends from the band: Benny Powell, Tee Carson, Bill Hughes, Frank Foster
summary: She lists good friends from the band, including neighbor Frank Foster, and says Basie remains like a big cloud over all.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Absolutely, yes, my goodness. There are so many good friends.
I was just going to say I’ll bet you have lots of good friends.

Lots of good friends. Well Benny Powell was always a good friend in the days when we were all in the band, and John Williams is an absolute doll. He’s the baritone player now with the band. He is the nicest man in the world. And we knew Tee Carson quite well when he was playing piano. We saw him recently in San Francisco at the Fairmont. And well Bill Hughes of course, who’s been there forever.
We saw Bill Hughes and Frank Foster together, and they gave us some wonderful things.
Frank Foster and we used to live in the same building in New York. Yes, we used to meet in the laundry room.
They did Foster and Hughes for this series.
Oh yes, oh, good, great. That should be good. Basie is still like a big cloud over all of it you know, he’s still got his arms around everyone.
